items.title: AutoPKG: An Automated Framework for Dynamic E-commerce Product-Attribute Knowledge Graph Construction
items.title_zh: AutoPKG：面向电商产品属性知识图谱自动构建的动态框架
items.summary: AutoPKG is a multi-agent LLM framework that induces product types and attribute keys on demand, extracts values from text and images, and consolidates updates through a centralized decision agent that keeps a canonical product-attribute graph consistent. On a Lazada catalog it reaches 0.953 weighted knowledge efficiency for product types and 0.531 edge-level F1 for multimodal value extraction, and online A/B tests attribute GMV lifts of 3.81% in Badge, 5.32% in Search and 7.89% in Recommendation.

items.title: HiveMind: OS-Inspired Scheduling for Concurrent LLM Agent Workloads
items.title_zh: HiveMind：面向并发 LLM 智能体负载的 OS 启发式调度
items.summary: HiveMind is a transparent HTTP proxy that applies five OS-inspired primitives, including admission control, rate-limit tracking, AIMD backpressure and priority queuing, to concurrent LLM agent workloads without changing agent code. Across 5-50 concurrent agents, uncoordinated runs failed at 72-100% rates while HiveMind cut failures to 0-18% and eliminated 48-100% of wasted compute, adding under 3ms of overhead.

items.title: LANTERN: Layered Archival and Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network for Long-Context LLM Conversations
items.title_zh: LANTERN：面向长上下文 LLM 对话的分层归档与时序情景检索网络
items.summary: LANTERN is a lightweight memory layer that archives every conversation turn and restores details lost during context compaction through hybrid retrieval, with no LLM calls and under 25ms of added latency per turn. On 94 multi-turn conversations it recovered 78.3% of facts lost to compaction versus 72.4% for a MemGPT-style baseline, and raised answer accuracy for four production LLMs by 8.4 percentage points on average.

items.title: The Consensus Trap: Rescuing Multi-Agent LLMs from Adversarial Majorities via Token-Level Collaboration
items.title_zh: 共识陷阱：以 token 级协作让多智能体 LLM 摆脱对抗性多数
items.summary: The paper shows majority voting in multi-agent LLM systems collapses when corrupted agents form a local majority, because voting only sees final answers and not flawed intermediate reasoning. It proposes token-level round-robin collaboration that interleaves agents' generation in a shared context, and experiments show it keeps accuracy robust beyond the point where majority voting fails.

items.title: Abstain-R1: Calibrated Abstention and Post-Refusal Clarification via Verifiable RL
items.title_zh: Abstain-R1：通过可验证强化学习实现校准弃答与拒答后澄清
items.summary: The authors propose a clarification-aware RLVR reward that jointly optimizes explicit abstention and semantically aligned post-refusal clarification on unanswerable queries while still rewarding correct answers on answerable ones. A trained 3B model, Abstain-R1, improves on Abstain-Test, Abstain-QA and SelfAware and reaches unanswerable-query behavior competitive with larger systems including DeepSeek-R1.

items.title: GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning
items.title_zh: GraphDC：面向可扩展图算法推理的分治多智能体系统
items.summary: GraphDC splits an input graph into subgraphs, assigns each to a specialized agent and uses a master agent to combine local results with inter-subgraph information. The authors report consistent gains over existing methods, especially on larger graphs.

items.title: mEOL: Training-Free Instruction-Guided Multimodal Embedder for Vector Graphics and Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: mEOL：面向矢量图形与图像检索的免训练指令引导多模态嵌入器
items.summary: mEOL uses a multimodal LLM to map text, raster images and SVG code into an aligned embedding space, steering embeddings with modality-specific instructions and structural SVG cues instead of learned projection heads or contrastive training. A semantic SVG rewriting module exposes geometric and relational cues, and on a repurposed VGBench text-to-SVG retrieval benchmark the training-free embeddings outperform encoder-based and training-based multimodal baselines.

items.title: CogGen: A Cognitively Inspired Recursive Framework for Deep Research Report Generation
items.title_zh: CogGen：受认知启发的深度研究报告递归生成框架
items.summary: CogGen uses a hierarchical recursive architecture to support flexible planning and global restructuring in deep research report generation, plus an abstract visual representation language for iteratively refining visual-text layouts. The authors introduce the Cognitive Load Evaluation Framework and an OWID-derived benchmark, and report state-of-the-art results among open-source systems that surpass Gemini Deep Research.

items.title: Evaluating a Layered Prompt-Injection Defence for the Model Context Protocol: A Record-Level Audit of Decision Conventions, Corpus Provenance and Reproducibility
items.title_zh: 评估面向模型上下文协议的分层提示注入防御：决策约定、语料来源与可复现性的记录级审计
items.summary: The paper audits CASCADE, a local layered defence combining rule matching, embedding similarity and optional local-model review, on a frozen 5,000-sample MCP prompt-injection corpus at the level of individual decision records. It shows headline detection figures depend heavily on how allow, review and block outcomes are collapsed into a binary label and on corpus wrappers, and derives a ten-item reporting checklist.

items.title: SeekerGym: A Benchmark for Reliable Information Seeking
items.title_zh: SeekerGym：面向可靠信息检索的基准
items.summary: SeekerGym benchmarks how completely AI agents retrieve information, using documents such as Wikipedia articles and ML survey papers as tasks, and also measures whether agents quantify how much may be missing. The best methods retrieve 42.5% of passages on Wikipedia and 29.2% on ML surveys.

items.title: Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
items.title_zh: Graph-of-Agents：基于图的多智能体 LLM 协作框架
items.summary: Graph-of-Agents models multi-agent LLM collaboration as a graph, sampling relevant agents from model cards, ordering them by comparing their responses, passing messages in both directions and pooling results. With a pool of six models it outperforms multi-agent baselines while using only three agents, according to the authors.

items.title: SciImpact: A Multi-Dimensional, Multi-Field Benchmark for Scientific Impact Prediction
items.title_zh: SciImpact：面向科学影响力预测的多维、多领域基准
items.summary: SciImpact spans 19 fields and 215,928 contrastive paper pairs to test LLM prediction of scientific impact across citations, awards, media attention, patents and artifact adoption. The authors report that multi-task supervised fine-tuning lets a 4B model outperform 30B models and closed-source o4-mini.
